translatedData.title: Staggered profit-taking: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss means cutting fear, while taking profits means cutting greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the staggered profit-taking strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage 1: When it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), close 1/3 of the position to lock in some gains,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage 2: When it reaches the second target,
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), take off another 1/3. Stage 3: Let the rest run with a trailing stop. If it drops below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you close the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you'll often watch your gains evaporate and end up back where you started.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than simply whether you use one. Place it too close and it gets hit every day; too far and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-loss orders.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Adjust position size based on the stop distance: if the distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on a single trade is still a set percentage of your capital.

The results-sharing section is full of winners because the people who lost don’t post.

The day they got liquidated, they just turned off their phones and went to sleep. Nobody wants to share their ugliest screenshots.

I used to see things that way too. The more I looked, the more I felt stupid. Only later did I realize that the people I was comparing myself to weren’t the whole picture.

When you see someone posting their gains, ask yourself first: where did all the people who didn’t post go?

translatedData.content:
Let’s talk about address poisoning.
Some wallets and block explorers flag or hide by default zero-value transfers suspected of being part of a poisoning attack.
One thing many people overlook: address poisoning doesn’t require stealing your private key or getting you to sign an authorization. It relies entirely on the habit of copying addresses from transaction history and checking only the first and last few characters.
Ignore small transfers from unfamiliar addresses, and don’t save the sender’s address as a frequently used address.
Addresses that frequently send and receive stablecoins and $ETH  are more likely to be targeted by address poisoning.

【ETH is rebounding, but ETFs are seeing heavy outflows】

ETH is up 3.2% today, trading at $2,467. Looking back a week, it’s still down 1.4% over seven days. A month ago, it was at its ATH—it's now pulled back about 50.1%. Price, sentiment, and ETF flows are moving in different directions.

In practical terms, ETF issuers, brokerages, and projects that depend on incremental liquidity will feel the impact first. DeFi, RWA, and on-chain payments with genuine business models may instead gain lower-cost users from this shakeout. The fact that prices are holding up despite outflows could mean buyers are stepping in behind the scenes, but I’m not sure whether that’s driven by spot demand or short-term leverage.

My take: What ETH lacks right now isn’t a story, but money that sticks around. Share in the comments: what Alpha have you spotted?

📰 Why are bank credit cards becoming the new stablecoin battleground?

Euronet and Fireblocks have teamed up on a major initiative to bring stablecoins to the credit cards of banks and fintech companies. Put simply, banks will be able to issue credit cards backed by stablecoins, with Fireblocks providing the wallet technology behind the scenes. This creates a new connection point between traditional payments and crypto.

Why does this matter?
At the heart of this is the “crypto-ization” of payment infrastructure. Essentially, it means regulators are allowing crypto to reach everyday payment scenarios in a more compliant and convenient way. Euronet’s Ren system and Fireblocks’ embedded wallet technology give banks a ready-made stablecoin payment solution. Since FTX collapsed, regulators have actually become clearer in their stance on stablecoins: find the right approach, and a compliant framework can be built. This news marks another step forward in expanding crypto payment use cases.

Impact on the market
From a market perspective, this won’t directly drive up the price of BTC or ETH, but it could change the flow of funds. On the one hand, stablecoins gaining traction through credit cards could accelerate their market share and potentially squeeze out established stablecoins like USDC. On the other hand, banks’ involvement could attract traditional finance players to hold more stablecoins as reserves. For historical context, before Circle was approved by the Federal Reserve last year, it went through a similar phase of infrastructure development.

💡 The bullish case for this news is that it lowers the “customer acquisition barrier” for crypto, but this depends on banks being able to manage the risks. If a large-scale bank failure like Silvergate’s happens in the future, this model could be shut down. In short: regulations are loosening, but banks need to be willing to take part.

这件事的核心是支付基础设施的"加密化"，本质是监管允许加密货币以更合规、更便捷的方式触达大众支付场景。Euronet 的 Ren 系统和 Fireblocks 的嵌入式钱包技术，相当于给了银行一套现成的稳定币支付解决方案。近期 FTX 倒台后，监管层对稳定币的态度其实更明确：只要找对路子，合规框架是能搭出来的。这条新闻意味着加密货币的支付场景拓展又往前走了一步。

以太坊市场深度分析：ETF资金外流与基本面改善形成拉锯

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月二十一日晚间，以太坊现货报价二千四百九十四美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之一点八六，盘中最高触及二千五百二十一美元，最低下探二千四百八十四美元。从小时K线来看，价格在二千四百九十至二千五百二十美元区间内窄幅震荡，整体呈现高位整理态势。

以太坊本轮反弹的支撑因素主要来自基本面改善。摩根大通将JPM Coin结算扩展至以太坊主网，Grayscale也开放了实物申购机制，这两大机构级进展显著提振了市场对以太坊的信心。此外，质押供应量创下历史新高，达到四千三百八十万枚ETH，占流通量的百分之三十五点九，有效收紧了现货市场的可交易供应。在交易时段内，净买入一度超过八千五百万美元，推动价格从二千四百四十九美元拉升至二千五百一十五美元，随后进入高位盘整。

然而，以太坊现货ETF在十月份累计净流出超过十亿八千万美元，创下历史最大单月流出纪录，完全抹去了九月份的全部涨幅。这一数据与比特币ETF的强劲流入形成鲜明对比，反映出机构投资者在两大加密资产之间的配置偏好正在分化。

二、技术指标解读

从移动平均线系统来看，七小时均线报二千五百零三美元，二十五小时均线报二千四百七十美元，九十九小时均线报二千四百二十四美元，三线呈多头排列，价格运行在均线系统上方，短期趋势偏多。指数移动平均线同样确认多头格局，七小时EMA报二千四百九十六美元，与当前价格高度贴合。

MACD指标方面，DIF线报十七点六五，信号线报十六点七六，柱状线为零点八九。MACD虽然仍处于零轴上方，但DIF与信号线的差距持续收窄，柱状线已连续多个周期缩小，显示上涨动能正在快速衰减。若柱状线转负，可能触发短期回调。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI从此前的高点八十八点四五回落至六十三点一三，十二周期RSI报六十五点三七，二十四周期RSI报六十二点八四。短周期RSI从超买区域回落至中性偏强区间，显示短期超买压力已有所释放，但仍有一定的下行空间。

KDJ指标中K值报六十二点九九，D值报六十八点三零，J值报五十二点三六。K线已下穿D线形成死叉信号，J值跌至五十附近，短期偏空信号较为明确。随机RSI指标报三十二点一四，已进入偏低区域，显示短期动量较弱。

布林带方面，上轨报二千五百二十四美元，中轨报二千四百七十四美元，下轨报二千四百二十二美元。价格运行于中轨与上轨之间，但接近上轨后未能有效突破，短期可能回落至中轨附近寻求支撑。

ATR十四周期报十七点六零，波动率持续收敛，市场可能即将迎来方向性突破。

三、市场情绪分析

综合十五个量化因子来看，十个因子发出做多信号，五个因子发出做空信号，多头占据明显优势。然而综合指标当前给出做空信号，历史胜率为百分之六十三点八三，显示短期空头信号具有较高的可靠性，投资者需要保持警惕。

市场情绪层面，以太坊正面临基本面利好与资金面利空的双重拉锯。一方面，机构采用持续深化，质押供应创新高收紧流通量，链上活跃度保持健康；另一方面，ETF的创纪录资金外流和Drift协议黑客持续抛售的阴影给价格带来实质性压力。Drift攻击者近期通过Tornado Cash转移了超过四万四千五百枚ETH，价值约一亿零九百万美元，其钱包中仍持有约五万六千五百枚ETH，随时可能继续抛售。

风险方面需要关注三点：一是现货ETF持续赎回带来的结构性分配压力；二是Drift黑客剩余ETH的潜在抛售风险；三是价格在前高附近遇阻后可能出现的回调需求。若以太坊能够有效站稳二千五百美元上方并伴随成交量放大，则有望打开进一步上涨空间；反之，若跌破二千四百七十美元的中轨支撑，短期可能回测二千四百五十美元一线。

subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math of Going All-In—After Reading This, Would You Still Dare?
translatedData.subTitle:
Say a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when it’s right and losing 50% when it’s wrong. Sounds good, right?
If you go all-in every time, the long-term math looks like this: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
Looks like positive expected value. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean a 75% loss, and you’d need a 300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

Same strategy, but use only 20% of your bankroll each time: two losses in a row = -18%, barely a dent,
and you still capture the long-term expected gains. The strategy hasn’t changed; only the position size has—and that can mean the difference between survival and ruin.

⑥ 恐慌期：连续暴跌，割肉声一片——而下一轮的种子就埋在这里。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but nobody believes it. Everyone’s shouting, “It’s a dead-cat bounce—sell into it.”
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts start turning bullish, and retail investors cautiously buy in.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group chat start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy pullback—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge again and again, and everyone is selling at a loss—and this is where the seeds of the next cycle are sown.

ETH | Geth releases Hoodi testnet version | Mainnet launch still awaits announcement

My stance is to observe, not to dress up a client release as a sign that ETH is about to surge on an upgrade. Ethereum execution client Geth has officially released v1.17.9. The release notes state that it supports the Amsterdam rules activating on the Hoodi testnet as scheduled on October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC, and recommend that Hoodi node operators update. The Ethereum Foundation’s earlier upgrade announcement also made clear that this arrangement applies only to Hoodi; mainnet activation will be announced separately. These two primary sources corroborate each other, so “the testnet is ready” is a fact, while “mainnet has already upgraded and fees have fallen” is not.

This release includes technical details worth tracking. Geth lists an approximately 16% speedup in EVM interpreter opcode dispatch, along with fixes related to database corruption during power loss, concurrent reads, and block-level access lists. That 16% refers to a performance improvement in a specific software implementation component. It cannot be translated into a 16% increase in ETH transaction speed, much less a gain in the token’s price. The more important market mechanism is that multiple clients passing the testnet successfully can reduce execution risk for the official deployment; compatibility or stability problems, on the other hand, could delay the mainnet timeline. Development progress has value, but it does not mean an immediate inflow of capital.

At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,496, with a daily open of about $2,447 and a rolling 24-hour low of about $2,431 and high of about $2,525. The price remains above the daily open, but has not held above the previous high; I would not attribute this price movement to the Geth release. The flow data also needs to be read with the timing in mind: in Farside’s individual ETH ETF table, the combined net outflow on October 20 was $26.1 million, while the columns for each fund on October 21 still show dashes. The 0.0 at the bottom of the page is only a placeholder for data not yet reported. It should not be treated as zero flows, let alone as evidence that institutions have turned into net buyers.

If I were trading myself, I would sit out for now and consider only a spot long if the conditions are met, with no high leverage. The entry trigger is an hourly close back above $2,525, followed by a retest that holds. I would cap the position at 3% of total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,580, then exit the remainder at the second target of $2,650. After entry, I’d set a stop-loss at $2,470 and close the entire position if it is hit. If the price fails to break out and then falls below $2,431, or if a blocking issue arises in the Hoodi test, I would cancel the bullish plan and stay out of the market. Conversely, I would have more confidence in my view only if the price holds above the previous high and subsequent mainnet announcements and ETF data improve in tandem. I will not describe the plan as a trade unless its trigger is met.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH｜Geth发布Hoodi测试网版本｜主网上线仍待公告

我的态度是观察，不把客户端发版包装成ETH即将因升级暴涨。以太坊执行客户端Geth正式发布v1.17.9：版本说明写明支持Hoodi测试网在10月26日17:42:48 UTC按预定时间启用Amsterdam规则，并建议运行Hoodi节点的运营者更新。以太坊基金会此前的升级公告也明确说明，这一安排只针对Hoodi，主网激活会另行公告。两份一手资料互相印证，因此“测试网准备就绪”是事实，“主网已经升级、手续费已经下降”不是事实。

这次发版有值得跟踪的技术内容。Geth说明列出EVM解释器操作码分发提速约16%，以及断电时数据库损坏、并发读取和区块级访问列表相关的修复。这里的16%是特定软件实现环节的性能改进，不能换算成ETH交易速度提高16%，更不能换算成币价涨幅。对市场更重要的机制是：多客户端顺利通过测试网，可以降低正式部署时的执行风险；若出现兼容性或稳定性问题，主网时间表反而可能推迟。开发进度有价值，却不是即时资金流入。

写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2496美元，日开约2447美元，滚动24小时低点约2431美元、高点约2525美元。价格仍高于日开，但没有守住前高；我不会把这段涨跌归因于Geth发版。资金面也需要分清时点：Farside逐只ETH ETF表中10月20日合计净流出2610万美元，10月21日各基金栏仍是横杠，页面尾部0.0只是尚未填报时的占位，不能当成零流量，更不能宣称机构已转为净买入。

如果是我自己交易，此刻先不参与，方向只考虑条件满足后的现货多单，不做高杠杆。入场触发是小时收盘重新站上2525美元，随后回踩不破；总资金仓位最多3%。第一目标2580美元减半，第二目标2650美元再减剩余部分；入场后止损设在2470美元，触及即全部平仓。若未突破就跌破2431美元，或者Hoodi测试出现阻断性问题，我直接取消偏多计划并保持空仓。反过来，只有价格站稳前高、后续主网公告与ETF数据同步改善，才会提高判断的把握度；计划未触发绝不写成成交。

Drift’s stolen funds move again: What does a transfer to a mixer mean?

Does seeing a large amount of ETH enter a mixer mean the market should expect selling pressure? There’s a missing piece of evidence here—don’t let a transfer alert draw the conclusion for you. 🔎

According to a report by Decrypt’s Jose Antonio Lanz, published on October 20, 2026, at 20:46 UTC, wallets linked to the Drift attack deposited 25,700 ETH into Tornado Cash over roughly two hours. Citing Arkham data, the report said that the addresses involved still held a large amount of ETH at the time of publication.

Mixing makes it harder to link funds to publicly visible addresses. But that alone does not establish that the funds have been sold, nor that tracking has become completely impossible. The source did not verify the transfer’s practical impact on freezing the funds, recovering them, or filing claims.

Another distinction worth keeping in mind: opening claims for compensation does not mean losses are fully covered by available funds. According to the report, when claims opened on October 1, there was a significant gap between the recovery pool’s funds and the verified losses. Future compensation depends on factors including protocol revenue, external funding, and the recovery of stolen funds; Tether’s funding commitment should not be treated as money already received.

My takeaway is that when assessing DeFi security, it’s important to examine separately who can move the assets and what will be available to compensate users if something goes wrong: How are administrator privileges constrained? How much has actually been deposited into the recovery pool? Are the compensation rules public? These questions can help you understand the risks you’re taking better than looking at yields alone.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people have never stopped to wonder what makes it worth $1.

【How it works】The stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, it issues you 1 USDT, and puts
dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can ask the issuer to
redeem with the issuer. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
The price may occasionally deviate slightly (for example, to $0.999), but arbitrageurs quickly bring it back in line.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market volatility grind away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. Stay flat when you don’t understand the market,
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling it out; stay flat after a few losing trades in a row—the money you save at these three moments
is more than most traders make.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. Keep your capital on hand, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have bullets to fire. Hold on to your bullets.

title: Crypto Holds Its Breath: Bitcoin Stalls, Ether Sags, and Solana's Big Upgrade Meets a Cautious Marke
subTitle:
October 22, 2026
Crypto has spent the past couple of weeks going sideways. Nobody is panicking, but nobody is celebrating either.
Bitcoin: stuck in a range, waiting on the Fed
Bitcoin opened at $82,940 on Wednesday, up 1.3% from the day before, and climbed past $83,000 in morning trading. That's a decent bounce, but it sits below the early-October highs, when bitcoin pushed back above $86,000, a level it hadn't touched since January. The dip on October 15 took it close to $81,000, and Glassnode said the loss-taking that day looked like the selling waves that coincided with local bottoms in August and September.  (Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, October 21, 2026: Crypto to outperform stocks and gold? +2)
The usual suspects are weighing on sentiment. Persistent inflation, worries about a possible Fed rate hike, rising oil prices and outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs are all in the mix. Brent crude was above $106 last week, and two inflation reports came in hotter than analysts expected. Traders now have the Fed's October 27–28 meeting circled on the calendar. One analyst note says the level to watch is $84,200 to $85,000, and a sustained move above it would improve short-term momentum. There is some optimism too, since J.P. Morgan Asset Management's team believes better price performance is ahead.  (Bitcoin at $83K: Best Cryptocurrencies to Buy During the Dip (October 2026) +4)
Ethereum: the harder year
Ether is having a rougher time than bitcoin. It was trading around $2,450 on Wednesday, up 1.7% on the day, but it's still a long way from where it stood a year ago. Fortune's October 15 snapshot had ETH down roughly 41% from the same date last year.  (Yahoo Finance)  (Fortune)
The ETF numbers don't help. US spot Ether ETFs have seen about $1.08 billion of outflows this month, the largest monthly withdrawal of the year. In the latest sell-off, Ethereum positions also saw bigger liquidations than Bitcoin. Staking and the developer ecosystem are still strong, but fund investors haven't been moved by that so far.  (volity)  (coin-turk)
Solana: big upgrade, lukewarm money
Solana was due to switch on Alpenglow on Wednesday. It replaces the TowerBFT consensus system and aims to cut transaction finality from about 12.8 seconds to around 150 milliseconds. It's being called the network's largest upgrade ever. One quirk is that vote transactions are being removed from blocks, so reported total transactions and TPS will look sharply lower even though real activity isn't dropping. Don't let a scary-looking dashboard fool you. I couldn't find confirmation yet of how the rollout actually went, so check the Solana Foundation's updates before drawing conclusions.  (kucoin)  (kucoin)
The money side is quieter. SOL was around $104.50 ahead of the launch. Solana ETFs saw $24.8 million in outflows last week, ending a 14-week run of inflows.  (coingape)  (diariobitcoin)
USDT: shrinking a little, and under political fire
Tether's USDT has a market cap of about $183 billion and holds over 60% of the stablecoin market. But it shed nearly $1 billion in market cap over five days in mid-October, and balances on major exchanges are down $4.6 billion since early July. Some of that money moved to USDC and RLUSD, though the $1.9 billion they gained doesn't fully cover the gap. That matters because bitcoin rallies have tended to come with growing stablecoin supply.  (Tether CEO Claims Wallet Freezes Cut Iran-Linked Stablecoin Volumes by 94% Since 2023 +2)
Tether also has a Washington problem. A Senate report examined 846 sanctioned Iran-linked wallets and found 84% of them mostly used USDT. CEO Paolo Ardoino pushed back, saying Tether's freezes cut Iran-linked volumes by 94%. There's a caveat, though: that figure has no published methodology, though TRM Labs data does show USDT's share of Iran-linked on-chain volume falling from 67% in 2025 to 14% in August. Separately, Tether-backed Utexo plans to launch USDT on Bitcoin this month, with private transfers and direct BTC swaps.  (Tether says Iran-linked USDT volumes fell 94% after freezes +3)
The bottom line
It's a market waiting for a catalyst. Bitcoin is holding the low $80,000s, Ether is struggling to attract institutional cash, and Solana is betting that technology can pull in buyers. The Fed meeting next week could break the stalemate in either direction.
This is a news summary, not financial advice. Prices move fast, so check live figures before making any decisions.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own trades. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (what your rationale was), what went wrong or right (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Keep it up for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover: your losses...
Your trade history is full of the same kinds of mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing direction immediately after a stop-loss,
or never being able to hold on to winning trades.

Market conditions change, but your behavioral patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

translatedData.content:
ETH Breaks Above $2,500 | Geth State Database Optimization Still Under Review | I Don’t Treat a Code Proposal as a Reason for a Rally

My stance is cautiously bullish: the price is showing resilience, but different kinds of evidence should not be conflated. Geth project pull request #35973 proposes replacing hierarchical lookups in the path-based state database with a Bloom filter index, moving some index maintenance out of the critical path for updates. As of my check, the project page still marked it as Open. It had received review comments, but the branch had not been deployed. This is performance engineering for node software—not an Ethereum protocol upgrade—and it certainly does not mean ETH transaction fees are lower today, mainnet throughput has suddenly increased, or the token’s value should be immediately repriced.

Why is this small change still worth watching? Ethereum execution-layer clients constantly update and query state. More efficient internal state access could, over time, improve the node-running experience and reduce resource costs. But there are still testing and risk-assessment steps between a Geth code change and a stable release, node adoption, and a change in the experience across the network. Other clients may not adopt the same implementation either. So this is more of an infrastructure-quality signal than a news-driven candle to buy on immediately. I also checked Geth’s official releases page; an unmerged PR should not be treated as if it were already in a stable release.

Flows offer a more practical counterbalance. In Farside’s daily table by individual ETF, U.S. spot Ethereum funds saw combined net outflows of about $26.1 million on October 20 and about $103.3 million on October 19. The product columns for October 21 still show dashes; the trailing 0.0 displayed automatically just means the data is incomplete, not that there were “zero outflows that day.” This does not prove that institutions are uniformly bearish, since ETFs do not cover all buying activity, but it reminds me not to claim that funds are flowing back across the board just because the price is rising. Rising prices and previous net outflows from funds can coexist; there is no need to invent a single cause.

As for market performance, Kraken’s ETH/USD quote was around $2,513, with a daily open of $2,446.55 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,422.50 and high of $2,524.58. The price is now well above the daily open, but that cannot be attributed to this PR. In the short term, I’ll first watch whether $2,500 holds after a retest, then whether the intraday high near $2,525 can be decisively cleared. If the price spikes and then falls back below $2,500, repeatedly failing to reclaim it, my bullish view weakens. If it also loses the area around $2,445, the current upward structure is essentially invalidated, and I’ll need to reassess flows and the broader market.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase the price around $2,513. I would only consider a small spot long position, capped at 5% of account funds. If the price pulls back to $2,495–$2,502 and then regains and holds above $2,505, I’d start with a 2% test position. If it breaks above $2,525 and holds on a retest, I’d add up to a maximum of 5%. The first target is $2,555, where I’d sell half; the second is $2,590, where I’d close the rest in stages. If the price falls below $2,478 after opening the test position, I’d stop out immediately and would not add to a losing position. I’d also exit early if BTC drops sharply at the same time or subsequent ETF data deteriorates significantly. If these conditions don’t materialize, I’d stay out of the market. The code proposal itself is not an entry signal.

Sources: Geth project PR #35973 and official releases page; Farside’s daily ETH ETF table by individual fund. Price is a Kraken ETH/USD snapshot. #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH站上2500美元｜Geth状态数据库优化仍在审阅｜我不把代码提案当上涨理由

我的态度是谨慎偏多：价格有韧性，但证据不能混用。Geth项目的#35973拉取请求提出，用布隆过滤器索引替换路径状态数据库的层级查找，把部分索引维护移出更新的关键路径。项目页面截至我核查时仍标为Open，已有审阅意见，但分支没有部署。这是节点软件的性能工程，不是以太坊协议已经升级，更不能直接推导出ETH交易手续费今天下降、主网吞吐突然提高或代币价值立刻重估。

这个小变化为什么仍值得看？以太坊执行层客户端需要不断更新和查询状态。若状态访问的内部维护更高效，长期可能改善节点运行体验和资源开销；但从一项Geth代码修改到正式版本、节点采用，再到全网体验变化，中间还有测试和风险评估。另一家客户端也未必采用同样实现。因此它更像基础设施质量信号，而不是一根可以马上买入的消息K线。我同时查看Geth正式发布页，不能把未合并的PR当成已经进入稳定版。

资金面提供了一个更现实的制衡。Farside逐只ETF日表中，10月20日美国现货以太坊基金合计约净流出2610万美元，10月19日约净流出1.033亿美元；10月21日各产品栏目前仍是横杠，尾部自动显示0.0只是未填完，绝不是“当日零流出”。这并不证明机构一致看空，因为ETF也不覆盖所有买盘，却提醒我不要只看价格上涨就宣称资金全面回流。上升的价格与此前基金净流出可以同时成立，不需要硬编单一因果。

市场表现上，我查询Kraken的ETH/USD约2513美元，日开2446.55美元，滚动24小时低点2422.50、高点2524.58。价格已经明显高于日开，但不能归因于这项PR。短线先看2500能否在回踩后守住，再看2525附近的日内高点能否有效越过；若冲高后跌回2500并反复不能收回，偏多判断削弱。若连2445附近也失守，则本轮上行结构基本被推翻，必须重新观察资金和大盘。

如果是我自己交易，不在2513附近追高，方向只考虑现货小仓做多，账户资金上限5%。若回踩2495—2502美元后重新站稳2505，先用2%试仓；若突破2525且回测不破，最多补到5%。第一目标2555美元，到位减半；第二目标2590美元，余仓分批平掉。试仓后跌破2478美元立即止损，不补亏损仓；若BTC同步急跌或后续ETF数据显著恶化，也提前退出。条件没出现就空仓，代码提案本身不是入场信号。

来源：Geth项目PR#35973与正式发布页、Farside ETH ETF逐只日表；价格为Kraken ETH/USD快照。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

$ETH has climbed above $2,500 for the first time in ten days.

On October 21, Ether opened at $2,446 and climbed steadily, breaking above $2,500 intraday to reach $2,501.5. According to Trading News data, it closed at $2,518, up about 5.8% from Tuesday morning. This was the first time Ether had crossed the $2,500 mark since October 14.

What makes this rally significant is the moving averages. The 20-day EMA at $2,499.6 and the 50-day EMA at $2,482 had capped nearly every Ether rebound for almost a month. If the daily candle closes above $2,500, it will be the first “meaningful reclaim” since the failed rebound on October 14. The next level to watch is $2,550, reportedly the threshold technical analysts see as confirmation of another leg up.

I think this rally has three forces behind it:

First, a short squeeze. From Coinbase’s low of $2,369 to the intraday high, Ether moved $148 in less than two days—a move with a strong short-squeeze feel.

Second, institutions are buying the dip. Tom Lee’s Bitmine just staked another $390 million worth of $ETH, bringing its total treasury holdings to 6.04 million tokens. Of those, 86.5% are locked in staking, earning yield and temporarily removed from the circulating supply. Consider the timing: Ether has fallen below $2,000 several times this year, and Bitmine’s treasury holdings were once sitting on $6 billion to $8 billion in paper losses, yet the company kept buying. That kind of “buy more as it falls” behavior at least suggests that big-money investors don’t think this is a bear market.

Third, staking is hitting record levels. A total of 43.8 million $ETH is staked across the network, equivalent to 35.9% of the circulating supply—the highest level ever. The more tokens locked in staking, the fewer freely tradable coins there are on the market.

But don’t get carried away with the bullish outlook. U.S. spot Ether ETFs have seen $1.08 billion in net outflows this month, with outflows on 13 of the past 14 trading days. Price and fund flows are “at odds”: this rally has been driven by short covering, while ETF money hasn’t returned yet. For Ether to hold above $2,500, we’ll also need to see whether ETF outflows can stop bleeding.

In the same market, Bitcoin has climbed back above $84,000, up about 1.6%, while the Fear & Greed Index has risen to 68, in the greed zone. AI earnings season has reignited risk appetite: SpaceX reported third-quarter revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year over year, and Super Micro also raised its revenue guidance. Ether’s rally looks more like a combination of “catching a tailwind and squeezing shorts” than a standalone reversal in fundamentals.

我觉得这次拉升有三层推力：

第一，空头挤压。Coinbase低点2369美元到盘中高点，不到两天148美元的波动，逼空味道很正。

第二，机构在跌里买。Tom Lee旗下的Bitmine刚刚又把3.9亿美元的$ETH拿去质押，国库总量冲到604万枚，其中86.5%锁在质押里吃利息、暂时退出流通盘。注意时间点：以太今年多次跌穿2000美元，国库账面曾浮亏60到80亿美元，人家照买不误。这种“越跌越买”的手，至少说明大资金不觉得这是熊市。

The morning had just handed in its paper: 83,439 held for four straight 4h candles, and 84,898 was almost within reach. The invalidation level set this morning has now been triggered, so by our rules this push is downgraded to a “wick above,” not a hold. The details look worse than the conclusion: this morning, I said volume was declining as price pushed higher. Yet this 4h down candle came with a volume spike, with spot turnover at about $357 million—more than the roughly $270 million and $186 million on the two candles after the peak. On the 1h chart, the 09:00 candle first closed at 83,404, struggling right on the line; then the 10:00 candle closed at 82,917 on higher volume and broke below it. ETH fund inflows revised down after missing data was reported | BTC drops below $84K, spreading risk | Don’t try to catch the bottom near $2,439

My stance is cautious and watchful. I’m not treating a positive number on an ETF table as a buy signal. The newly trending #BitcoinDropsBelow$84K on Binance Square is also relevant to ETH: BTC is the anchor for market-wide risk appetite, but institutional flows into ETH need to be checked separately. Farside’s table of individual U.S. spot Ethereum funds showed that, before the ETHA figure was reported for October 21, the reported funds totaled approximately $44.2 million in net inflows. ETHA has now reported approximately $29.3 million in net outflows, bringing the full-day total down to about $14.9 million in net inflows. Grayscale’s ETH products saw approximately $28.1 million in inflows and FETH approximately $13 million, while major products also saw outflows in the opposite direction—showing that flows across channels were mixed. This is an update to data for the same trading day, not another equivalent-sized sell-off today. Automated summary tables may still be revised, so a provisional reading shouldn’t be presented as a permanent conclusion.

How is the market reacting? At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,439.09, with an opening price of $2,471.98, a rolling low of $2,431.88, and a high of $2,524.58. It was already below the day’s open. Meanwhile, BTC was trading below $84,000. Daily ETF creations and redemptions, immediate selling pressure during Asian trading, derivatives hedging, and macro expectations each operate on their own timelines, so it would be wrong to claim that ETH is falling right now because of ETHA outflows. BlackRock’s ETHA product website shows fund NAV information for October 21, which can serve as a cross-check that the product is operating, but a daily NAV change is not a fund flow and cannot replace Farside’s creations-and-redemptions table. My independent assessment is that a modest net inflow only indicates continued net demand at the product level on the previous trading day; it is not yet enough to prove that spot prices have finished bottoming.

For now, I’m watching two levels: $2,430, near today’s low, as support, and $2,470, around the opening price, as resistance. title: 核心开发先砍新品了：$SSV提案改「只维护」
subTitle:
以太坊 DVT 赛道的核心开发方，自己把新产品划出预算外了。

SSV Labs（ssv.network 核心开发）10月21日在治理论坛提交 DIP-59：在市况和 DAO 财务承压下，把后续工作从「扩路线图」收窄成网络维护、安全与以太坊升级适配；明确写了——本提案不含新产品/新协议开发，也不含营销预算。服务期拟延到 2027年6月30日，前半段还扛 Boole 网络分叉、以太坊 Glamsterdam（ePBS）适配、checkpoint sync；2027上半年进入维护期。

钱怎么改：2026年要 150万 $USDC；2027上半年要 270万枚 $SSV（其中 100万先付，另 170万可整笔改拿 90万美元现金——折合约每枚 0.53 美元）。提案还写明，原 DIP-31 第三期约 173.6万枚 $SSV 至今未付，要一并重谈。

注意：这是提案，不是已通过的决议。质押资金本身不等于立刻出事，但核心开发「只守不扩」说明协议金库跑道，已经比叙事更值得先看一眼。

信息来源：ssv.network 治理论坛 DIP-59 原文、ChainCatcher、@WuBlockchain。不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Core developers cut new products first: $SSV proposal shifts to “maintenance only”
translatedData.subTitle:
A core developer in Ethereum’s DVT sector has taken new products out of its own budget.

SSV Labs (the core developer of ssv.network) submitted DIP-59 to the governance forum on October 21. Amid market conditions and financial pressure on the DAO, it narrows future work from “expanding the roadmap” to network maintenance, security, and adapting to Ethereum upgrades. It explicitly states that the proposal includes no new product or protocol development, and no marketing budget. The service period is proposed to run through June 30, 2027. In the first half of that period, the team will still handle the Boole network fork, adaptation to Ethereum’s Glamsterdam (ePBS) upgrade, and checkpoint sync; the first half of 2027 will enter a maintenance phase.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn't an admission of failure—it's the price of admission for your next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I've ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they're wrong. Because they know: whether this one trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand shakes as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

Then it spreads to leading coins in each sector → finally sweeping up all kinds of small, obscure coins → the whole market rises and gets overheated; the rally
is nearing its end. You always feel like your coin is the last to rise, because you often buy right at the end of the rotation
chain.

#波卡社区基金会警示Fearless扩展泄露私钥 $ETH $DOT

【An admin key may have been compromised, leaving around 2,500 ETH in limbo】

This morning, security researcher Spreek disclosed that the admin keys for Swell’s swETH and rswETH may have been compromised. At the current price of $2,441, 2,500 ETH is worth around $6.1 million.

Here’s what’s confirmed so far 👇
🔹 The attacker is inflating the net asset value (NAV) by up to 1% per hour, without any assets to back it
🔹 Four malicious upgrade contracts have been deployed
🔹 These upgrades haven’t entered the multisig execution queue, and there’s currently no evidence that any assets have been stolen

Spreek also cautioned that some details in the report have yet to be verified. It’s unclear how Swell’s team will respond.

🔑 Why can one key control so much money?
swETH and rswETH use upgradeable proxy contracts. According to ADL’s analysis, the admin key controls the proxy’s admin permissions. Whoever has it can point the contract to a malicious implementation and mint or withdraw assets without anything to back them.
The rules for the tokens you hold ultimately come down to this key.

🔑 Another incident on the same day
The Web3 Foundation warned that four versions of the Fearless Wallet browser extension—3.0.1, 3.0.3, 3.0.4, and 3.0.5—contain malicious code that sends users’ private keys to an attacker when they unlock their wallets. The affected period spans February 2025 through October 10 this year. Eight users have reported suspicious transfers, totaling 17,286 DOT.

Dragonfly partner Haseeb also posted today that on-chain hack incidents are surging, but the total amount stolen this year is about the same as in 2025, while losses per incident are decreasing. Most small protocols have already been compromised, while larger protocols are using AI tools to strengthen their defenses.

If you hold any of the assets involved, here are a few steps you can take:
1️⃣ Hold swETH / rswETH: Wait for an official statement from Swell. Don’t rush to buy the dip if they trade at a discount on the secondary market.
2️⃣ Used the Fearless extension after February 2025: The foundation recommends treating every account in the extension as compromised. Create new private keys in another wallet and transfer your assets; changing your password or reinstalling the extension won’t help.
3️⃣ The Android / iOS mobile apps have been checked and do not contain malicious code, but any private keys imported from the extension should still be treated as compromised.
4️⃣ Staked tokens in DeFi: Check whether protocol upgrades require a multisig and timelock, or can be authorized with a single key.

Two important distinctions: a malicious contract being deployed ≠ funds being stolen; more hacks ≠ a greater total amount lost.

My own practice: I keep only small amounts for everyday use in browser-extension wallets, and only stake tokens in protocols with upgrade timelocks.

Have you checked who controls the upgrade permissions for the staked tokens you hold?

两条边界：恶意合约已部署≠钱已被盗；被黑事件变多≠损失总额变大。

translatedData.content:
An On-Chain Love Letter

Su Wan first met Lu Chen at an online meeting of the Ethereum developer community.

It was a late night in February. She was debugging a smart contract, and the Solidity code on her screen looked like an obscure poem. Halfway through the meeting, a low, calm voice came through her headphones, pointing out a reentrancy vulnerability in her contract. She paused and glanced back at the chat window. An avatar named "Vitalik_Dream" sat quietly there.

"Your code is beautiful, but it's missing a require," he said.

Those were their first words to each other.

Su Wan was a smart contract auditor at a blockchain company in Shanghai. She was twenty-six and used to working alone until the early hours. Lu Chen developed DeFi protocols in Shenzhen. He was three years older than her and, they said, had once worked on the core development of a well-known public blockchain. They gradually got to know each other in technical chat groups, talking about everything from gas fees to consensus mechanisms, from Layer 2 scaling solutions to their favorite CryptoPunk avatars.

One late night, Lu Chen suddenly sent her a piece of code.

"What is this?" she asked.

"Try deploying it to the testnet."

She copied the code into Remix, compiled it, deployed it, and called the contract. A line of text appeared on the screen: "Su Wan, you're the most elegant contract auditor I've ever met."

She smiled at the screen for a long time.

It was the first on-chain love letter he had written for her. No centralized server could delete it, and no one could tamper with it. It was written forever into an Ethereum block, alongside every other transaction, irreversible.

They began a long-distance relationship. Shanghai to Shenzhen: twelve hundred kilometers, like assets on two different chains that needed a bridge to interact. Every weekend, they took turns riding the high-speed train to see each other. They coded together over their laptops in cafés, sometimes argued over the merits of a technical solution, then settled every disagreement over hot pot.

Lu Chen liked describing their relationship in blockchain terms. He said their love was decentralized and needed no third party to verify it. He said their trust was a consensus mechanism that needed no intermediary to guarantee it. He said she was the most important transaction of his life, one he would confirm no matter how high the gas fee.

Su Wan thought he was cheesy, but she couldn't help smiling every time.

On the night in March 2025 when Bitcoin broke through $100,000, the entire crypto world was celebrating. Lu Chen called her, his voice unusually excited. "Wanwan, have you seen the price of BTC?"

"I have. $100,200," she said.

"I wrote you a new love letter on-chain."

She opened an Ethereum block explorer and found the transaction hash he had sent her. It was a contract call deployed on the Ethereum mainnet, and the contract stored a message: "When Bitcoin reached $100,000, my love for you grew beyond measure. This letter will live on-chain forever, just as you will live in my heart forever."

As she watched the transaction record on the screen and the number of confirmations kept rising, her eyes suddenly welled up.

That year, the market went through tremendous volatility. Bitcoin fell from $100,000 to $70,000, then rebounded to $82,000. Ethereum swung back and forth around $2,400. Countless people lost sleep, grew anxious, and broke down amid the wild surges and plunges. But Su Wan and Lu Chen's relationship was like a smart contract that had passed a stress test: the more extreme the market, the stronger it seemed.

"Do you know why our relationship will never get liquidated?" Lu Chen asked her once.

"Why?"

"Because we're not using leverage," he said with a laugh. "Our love is spot, it's long-term holding, it's faith that doesn't watch the charts."

Su Wan wrote that down in her journal.

Before they knew it, October had arrived. On an ordinary Thursday in the early hours, after finishing work, Su Wan picked up her phone and saw a message from Lu Chen. It wasn't code or a technical discussion, but a screenshot.

It was a new contract he had just deployed on the Ethereum mainnet. The contract stored a message and a tiny NFT. The NFT showed two hands holding each other, against a backdrop of candlestick charts and a starry sky.

"Wanwan, we've been together for two years. In that time, Bitcoin went from $60,000 to $82,000, and Ethereum fell from $3,000 to $2,400 before climbing back up. The market has changed a lot, but we haven't. This contract is my promise to you. It doesn't need an exchange to hold it in custody, because it's written directly onto the blockchain, into time itself."

Su Wan looked at her phone screen. Outside her window, it was four in the morning in Shanghai. Lights came on one by one in the distance, like new blocks continually being generated on the blockchain, each linked to the one before it, unbroken.

She replied with three words: "I've received it."

Then she opened her wallet and left her first comment beneath the transaction.

"Confirmed. Valid forever."

Every transaction on the blockchain must be confirmed before it becomes immutable history. And their love, from the very first line of code, had already been written into the eternal ledger. It needed no one to bear witness, because the entire chain was their witness.

content:
链上情书

苏晚第一次见到陆辰，是在以太坊开发者社区的线上会议里。

那是二月的一个深夜，她正在调试一份智能合约的代码，屏幕上的Solidity语言像一首晦涩的诗。会议进行到一半，一个声音从耳机里传来，低沉而平静，指出她合约中一个重入攻击的漏洞。她愣了一下，回头看了看聊天框，那个叫"Vitalik_Dream"的头像正安静地停在那里。

"你的代码写得很美，但缺少一个require。"他说。

那是他们的第一句话。

苏晚是上海一家区块链公司的合约审计师，二十六岁，习惯了一个人加班到凌晨。陆辰在深圳做DeFi协议开发，比她大三岁，据说曾经参与过某知名公链的核心开发。他们在技术群里渐渐熟络起来，从Gas费聊到共识机制，从Layer2的扩容方案聊到各自最喜欢的加密朋克头像。

有一天深夜，陆辰突然发给她一段代码。

"这是什么？"她问。

"你部署到测试网上看看。"

她把代码复制到Remix里，编译，部署，调用。屏幕上返回了一行文字："苏晚，你是我见过最优雅的合约审计师。"

她对着屏幕笑了很久。

那是他写给她的第一封链上情书。没有中心化的服务器可以删除它，没有任何人可以篡改它，它永远地写在了以太坊的区块里，和所有的交易记录一起，不可逆转。

他们开始了一段跨城的恋爱。上海到深圳，一千两百公里，像两条不同链上的资产，需要一座桥才能互通。每个周末他们轮流坐高铁见面，在咖啡馆里对着笔记本电脑一起写代码，偶尔争论某个技术方案的优劣，然后以一顿火锅结束所有的分歧。

陆辰喜欢用区块链的术语来形容他们的关系。他说他们的爱情是去中心化的，不需要任何第三方来验证。他说他们的信任是共识机制，不需要中介来担保。他说她是他生命中最重要的一笔交易，Gas费再高也要确认。

苏晚觉得他肉麻，但每次都忍不住笑。

二〇二五年三月，比特币突破十万美元的那天晚上，整个币圈都在狂欢。陆辰打电话给她，声音里带着少见的兴奋："晚晚，你看到BTC的价格了吗？"

"看到了，十万零两千。"她说。

"我在链上给你写了一封新的情书。"

她打开以太坊浏览器，找到他发来的交易哈希。那是一笔部署在以太坊主网上的合约调用，合约里存储了一段话："当比特币涨到十万，我对你的爱也涨到了不可估量。这封信永远在链上，就像你永远在我心上。"

她看着屏幕上那行交易记录，确认数不断增加，眼眶忽然就红了。

那一年，市场经历了剧烈的波动。比特币从十万跌到七万，又反弹到八万两千。以太坊在两千四百美元附近反复震荡。无数人在暴涨暴跌中失眠、焦虑、崩溃。但苏晚和陆辰的感情，却像经过压力测试的智能合约，越是在极端行情下，越显得稳固。

"你知道为什么我们的感情不会爆仓吗？"陆辰有一次问她。

"为什么？"

"因为我们没有杠杆。"他笑着说，"我们的爱是现货，是长期持有，是不看K线的信仰。"

苏晚把这句话记在了日记本里。

转眼到了十月。一个普通的周四凌晨，苏晚加班结束，打开手机，看到陆辰发来的消息。不是代码，不是技术讨论，而是一张截图。

那是他刚刚部署在以太坊主网上的一份新合约。合约里存储着一段话，和一枚小小的NFT。NFT的图案是两只手牵在一起，背景是K线图和星空。

"晚晚，我们在一起两年了。这两年里，比特币从六万涨到八万二，以太坊从三千跌到两千四又爬回来。市场变了很多，但我们没有变。这份合约是我给你的承诺，它不需要任何交易所来托管，因为它直接写在区块链上，写在时间里。"

苏晚看着手机屏幕，窗外是上海凌晨四点的天际线。远处的灯光一盏一盏亮起来，像区块链上不断生成的新区块，每一个都连着前一个，不可断裂。

她回复了三个字："我收到了。"

然后她打开钱包，在那笔交易下面，留下了她的第一条评论。

"已确认。永久有效。"

区块链上的每一笔交易都需要被确认，才能成为不可篡改的历史。而他们的爱情，从第一行代码开始，就已经被写进了永恒的账本里。不需要任何人见证，因为整条链，都是他们的证人。

If you typically hold or use dollar-denominated stablecoins, what matters most going forward is not just the price, but whether issuers can maintain adequate reserves and honor redemptions promptly in accordance with the rules. The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has issued the final implementing rule for the GENIUS Act, moving stablecoin regulation from legislation to implementation.

The rule takes effect on January 18, 2027, and covers U.S. and foreign payment stablecoin issuers under OCC jurisdiction, as well as certain custodial activities. Key areas include reserve assets, redemptions, risk management, audit reports, licensing and registration, capital, and operational safeguards.

For everyday users, stablecoin transparency and redemption requirements are likely to become clearer over time. However, rules on anti-money laundering, the Bank Secrecy Act, and sanctions will still be set separately by the U.S. Treasury, so experiences such as using stablecoins across platforms and identity verification may continue to change.

This does not mean all stablecoins will immediately become uniformly compliant. Rather, it marks a key step toward a U.S. federal framework. The next things to watch are when applications open and how existing issuers adjust their reserves, disclosures, and reward arrangements.

title: BTC与ETH，正在被机构当成两种资产
subTitle:
$BTC $ETH 表面上是币圈老大和老二，但从今年10月的资金数据看，机构已经把它们当成两种完全不同的资产在对待。

一、资金面：一个在吸金，一个在失血

美国现货ETF是最清楚的证据。截至10月中旬的30天里，比特币ETF净流入20.6亿美元，总规模突破1000亿美元，约占BTC流通量的6%；以太坊ETF同期净流出1.92亿美元，总规模只有144.8亿美元。

进入10月，分化更极端：ETH现货ETF单月净流出已达10.8亿美元，创2026年最大单月流出，把9月8.32亿美元的净流入全部吐了回去；BTC这边虽然10月整体小幅净流出约6700万，但周一单日就涌入5.27亿，周二再进2300万。10月7日，贝莱德的ETHA单日被赎回1.16亿美元，创单只基金纪录——同一天，资金在往比特币基金里走。

这不是资金离开币圈，是资金在币圈内部换仓：从ETH撤出，向BTC集中。

二、BTC的行业逻辑：核心资产化已经完成

三个信号说明比特币的机构定位已经定型。第一，摩根大通首次把比特币纳入长期资产预测，给出年化10%的回报预期——大行把BTC写进长期配置表，意味着它在机构眼里已经从"投机品"变成"资产类别"。第二，瑞士FINMA破例豁免分散投资要求，批准首只散户现货比特币ETF（BBIT）11月挂牌，欧洲的合规通道还在扩张。第三，贝莱德已在申请第三只比特币ETF。供给端有2100万枚硬顶，需求端是持续扩张的合规通道——BTC的故事，机构已经讲通了。

三、ETH的背离：网络被采用，代币被减持

以太坊现在处在一个拧巴的位置。一边，机构在用它的网络：摩根大通正把JPM Coin迁移到以太坊上，看中的是它的流动性和结算能力。另一边，基金经理在卖它的代币：ETF月流出破10亿，链上Gas费低到0.04—0.07 Gwei，网络活跃度明显清淡。

但链上还有另一组数据：ETH质押量创历史新高，4380万枚、占总供应量35.9%，连续第六个季度净流入。也就是说，长期信徒在把ETH锁进质押里，短期资金在从ETF里撤。ETH缺的不是技术叙事，是ETF渠道里那批钱的黏性——9月能流入8.3亿，10月就能流出10.8亿，这批钱来得快、走得也快。

四、核心判断

这轮分化不是"ETH不行了"，而是两种钱在分工：配置型资金买确定性，所以抱BTC；以太坊的价值捕获还在等下一个催化剂（监管定性、链上活动回暖、质押型ETF进展）。接下来盯三个变量：下周FOMC的利率信号、ETH ETF流出是否收敛、质押占比能否继续新高。前两个决定短期价格，第三个决定ETH的长期底盘。

（数据来源：SoSoValue、Cointelegraph、Farside、PANews。本文为行业信息分析，不构成投资建议。）

$BTC $ETH On the surface, they’re the crypto market’s number one and number two. But October’s fund-flow data shows that institutions are treating them as two entirely different assets.

1. Capital flows: one is attracting money, the other is bleeding

U.S. spot ETFs offer the clearest evidence. In the 30 days through mid-October, Bitcoin ETFs saw net inflows of $2.06 billion, bringing total assets above $100 billion—about 6% of BTC’s circulating supply. Ethereum ETFs, meanwhile, saw net outflows of $192 million over the same period, with total assets of just $14.48 billion.

The divergence grew even sharper in October: ETH spot ETFs have recorded $1.08 billion in net outflows for the month, the largest monthly outflow of 2026, wiping out all of September’s $832 million in net inflows. BTC ETFs, though slightly negative overall in October, with net outflows of about $67 million, still attracted $527 million on Monday alone, followed by another $23 million on Tuesday. On October 7, BlackRock’s ETHA saw $116 million in redemptions in a single day, a record for an individual fund. That same day, money was flowing into Bitcoin funds.

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of the morning of October 22 Beijing time, the spot price of Ethereum stood at $2,442, down 0.1% over the past 24 hours. Intraday, Ethereum briefly surged to around $2,515 before facing heavy selling pressure and retreating steadily to $2,437. This rise and reversal indicate significant overhead resistance. During the rally, the market recorded net inflows of more than $90 million, driving prices up rapidly. But the gains did not last: subsequent profit-taking and panic selling quickly erased them. Ethereum’s current market sentiment is shaped by a mix of factors. On the negative side, sustained, large-scale ETF outflows are the biggest source of pressure. 以太坊市场深度分析：超卖信号明显，ETF流出与安全事件构成压力

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月二十二日上午，以太坊现货价格报二千四百四十二美元，过去二十四小时微跌百分之零点一。从盘中走势来看，以太坊在盘中一度冲高至二千五百一十五美元附近，随后遭遇强力抛压，连续回落至二千四百三十七美元。这一冲高回落的走势表明上方阻力较为沉重。在上涨过程中，市场曾录得超过九千万美元的净流入，推动价格快速拉升，但好景不长，随后的获利了结和恐慌性抛售迅速吞噬了涨幅。从更深层的背景来看，以太坊质押量创下历史新高，达到四千三百八十万枚，占流通总量的百分之三十六，这在一定程度上锁定了供给。然而，以太坊现货ETF在过去一周净流出超过十五万五千枚，累计金额超过十亿美元，持续的机构赎回对价格形成了明显的压制。此外，JPM Coin扩展至以太坊网络以及德国Sparkspark银行面向五千万用户推出相关服务，为以太坊的长期结算应用增添了想象空间。

二、技术指标解读

从一小时级别的技术指标来看，以太坊同样处于深度超卖状态。RSI六周期指标降至十六点七七，RSI十二周期为三十三点六五，均处于极低水平。KDJ指标中K值仅为十一点六七，D值为二十三点三五，J值为负十一点六七，三线深度超卖，短期内存在技术修复的需求。MACD方面，快线持续下行逼近零轴，柱状图负值扩大至负八点四四，空头动能仍在释放但边际减弱。布林带上，价格跌穿中轨二千四百七十八美元并逼近下轨二千四百三十二美元，下轨附近可能形成短期支撑。均线系统中，七周期均线二千四百六十六已跌破二十五周期均线二千四百七十一，形成短期死叉，但九十九周期均线二千四百二十七仍在下方提供支撑。威廉指标降至负九十六点一二，确认市场处于极度超卖状态。整体来看，技术面与比特币类似，短期偏弱但超卖程度已经非常极端。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪受到多重因素交织影响。利好方面，质押量创新高和机构级结算应用的扩展为中长期基本面提供了支撑。利空方面，ETF持续大规模流出是最大的压力来源，过去一周超过十亿美元的赎回反映出部分机构投资者正在降低以太坊仓位。安全事件方面，Drift Protocol攻击者在沉寂两个月后再度活跃，将约四万四千五百一十枚以太坊通过Tornado Cash进行洗钱，金额约一亿零九百万美元，且仍持有约五万六千五百六十九枚以太坊。这一事件不仅给DeFi安全蒙上阴影，也增加了市场对大规模抛售的担忧。综合来看，以太坊短期面临ETF流出和安全事件的双重压力，但深度超卖的技术指标暗示反弹可能随时出现。投资者需关注二千四百三十美元附近的支撑有效性以及二千五百一十五美元上方的阻力。

translatedData.content:
ETH has had a rough month. Let me say something that may not sound nice.

U.S. spot ETH ETFs have seen $1.08 billion in net outflows so far in October—the biggest monthly outflow this year, and the month isn’t even over yet. BlackRock’s ETHA has been the main source of outflows, with another $33 million leaving on Tuesday alone.

Now compare that with BTC: BTC ETFs saw $527 million in net inflows on Monday, with BlackRock’s IBIT alone bringing in $665 million. Same BlackRock, but its clients are buying BTC and selling ETH.

The prices tell a similar story. ETH fell from around $2,700 to the low $2,400s in October, down nearly 10%. BTC, by contrast, has climbed back to its opening price for the month. The ETH/BTC ratio has mostly been trending down throughout October. BTC’s market share is now around 60%.

A lot of people tell me ETH’s fundamentals haven’t changed: stablecoins, L2s, the ecosystem—all still there. I agree. But unchanged fundamentals don’t mean the price has to go up. ETF flows are one of the clearest votes of confidence, and for a month straight, investors have been voting against it.

I still hold ETH, and it’s not a small position, so when I say this, I’m talking about myself too.

My approach: I’m not adding to my ETH position, but I’m not selling either. I’ll let its share of my total portfolio shrink naturally, and wait until ETHA posts net inflows for several days in a row before reconsidering. This month, I’d rather make a little less on BTC than bet on a turning point in ETH that hasn’t shown up yet. I don’t really buy the argument that “after such big outflows, it has to bounce.” Until the money comes back, a bounce is just a bounce.

There’s another interesting thing. When the ETFs were first approved, everyone said staking yields would make institutions favor ETH because it generates income. But when institutions actually voted with their money, they chose BTC, which doesn’t generate yield. My take is that for big investors, certainty matters more than a few percentage points of yield—and ETH currently has too many narratives and too little certainty.

It’s a similar story with SOL. Alpenglow just launched, bringing confirmation times down to 150 milliseconds—a very impressive technical achievement—but spot SOL ETFs have seen net outflows for 12 consecutive trading days. This month, tech upgrades and fund flows seem to be moving in two separate directions.

Some people will say ETH is at its best buying opportunity now, and that you should buy more as it falls. I’d like to hear the reasoning from those of you who think that: what signal are you waiting for? Or do you not look at fund flows at all?

#ETH #以太坊 #ETF

Not investment advice.

content:
ETH 这个月有点惨，说点不好听的。

美国现货 ETH ETF 10 月到现在净流出 10.8 亿美元，是今年最大的单月流出，月底还没到。贝莱德的 ETHA 是流出主力，周二一天又出了 3300 万。

对比一下 BTC：周一 BTC ETF 净流入 5.27 亿，贝莱德 IBIT 一家进了 6.65 亿。同一个贝莱德，客户买 BTC、卖 ETH。

价格也对得上。ETH 10 月从 2700 附近跌到 2400 多，跌了将近一成；BTC 同期反而站回了月初开盘价。ETH/BTC 这个比值，10 月基本是一路往下走的。BTC 市占现在 60% 左右。

很多人跟我说 ETH 基本面没变，稳定币、L2、生态都在。我同意。可是基本面没变不等于价格会涨，ETF 这种钱是最实在的投票，连续一个月在投反对票。

我手里现在还有 ETH，仓位不算小，所以这话说出来也是在说我自己。

我的处理：ETH 不加，也不割，任由它在总仓位里的比例自然变小，等 ETHA 连续几天转成净流入再说。这个月我宁可在 BTC 上少赚一点，也不想在 ETH 上赌一个还没出现的拐点。我不太相信"流出这么多该反弹了"这种说法，资金没回头之前，反弹也只是反弹。

还有个现象挺有意思。ETF 刚通过那会，大家都说质押收益会让机构更偏爱 ETH，因为它能生息。结果机构真用钱投票的时候，选的还是不生息的 BTC。我理解是对大资金来说，确定性比那几个点的收益更重要，而 ETH 现在叙事太多、确定性太少。

SOL 那边也一样，Alpenglow 刚上线，确认时间压到 150 毫秒，技术上很漂亮，但 SOL 现货 ETF 已经连续 12 个交易日净流出。技术升级和资金流向，这个月看起来是两条线。

有人会说现在是 ETH 最好的买点，越跌越买。我想听听这类朋友的逻辑：你是在等什么信号？还是根本不看资金面？

They all involve new projects issuing tokens to raise funds, so why are there several different terms?
As I understand it, the main difference is who organizes the offering: with an ICO, the project team sells tokens directly; an IEO is organized by an exchange; and an IDO takes place on-chain.
An IDO (Initial DEX Offering) is when tokens are first offered on a decentralized exchange or launchpad, and users subscribe directly with their wallets.
My approach: IDOs take place entirely on-chain. Before approving anything, I check the page and the contract address, since there are many fake pages.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several times leverage to ride a big trend, and roll it over a few times to
make dozens of times your initial investment. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What rolling positions involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to trade with leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, your unrealized gains
can go from dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】Rolling profits into new positions is essentially a matter of “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the odds of winning four times in a row
are just 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

ETH | ETF flows provisionally turn positive, but key funds are still missing | Wait until $2,460 is reclaimed

My stance is cautious: I’m not treating “provisional net inflows” as a confirmed reversal. Farside’s table of U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs by fund shows total net outflows of $103.3 million on October 19, followed by further net outflows of $26.1 million on the 20th. As of this writing, it lists net inflows of $44.2 million for the 21st. That change is worth noting, but ETHA and ETHB are still marked with dashes for the 21st, meaning their data has not yet been reported—not that their flows were zero. Among the funds reported so far, Grayscale ETH saw net inflows of $28.1 million, Fidelity FETH $13 million, and MSSE $1.3 million. Compared with the provisional figure of just $29.4 million reported earlier, the additional fund data has changed the reading; further updates could still change the total and its direction.

Why do ETF flows matter for ETH? ETF creations and redemptions give traditional investment accounts exposure to Ethereum. Only if net inflows continue for several days across multiple issuers are they more likely to indicate that demand is broadening beyond individual products. For now, positive flows are concentrated in a few funds that have reported, so we can’t conclude that institutions are increasing their allocations across the board—let alone equate fund flows directly with on-chain buying or Ethereum fee revenue. ETHA is a major product, and with its data missing, it’s too early to declare a “broad-based return to positive flows.” My verification process is to wait for data from all major funds, then see whether price confirms the flows in the same direction. If the two diverge, I’ll prioritize price action and risk management.

The market reaction also doesn’t support a simply optimistic headline. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,436, below the daily open near $2,472; the day’s low was around $2,434 and its high around $2,525. We can’t attribute the decline to ETF flows alone: macro risks, BTC volatility, and derivatives deleveraging could all be contributing at the same time. For me, $2,460 is the first short-term level ETH needs to reclaim, while $2,490 is an initial area to take profits. If the $2,434 low is decisively broken, the supposed improvement in fund flows has yet to translate into tradable price strength. Conversely, if total flows remain positive after the major funds report, and price holds above $2,460 and stays there on a retest, I’ll have more confidence that the rebound can continue.

资金面为何影响ETH？ETF份额申赎为传统投资账户提供以太坊敞口，若连续多日、多个发行人同步净流入，才更可能说明需求面从个别产品扩散。现在正数主要集中在少数已报告基金，不能据此说机构全面增配，更不能把基金流量直接等同链上买盘或以太坊手续费收入。ETHA是大型产品，缺这一栏时，用“全面转正”下结论过早。我的核验顺序是先等所有主要基金数据齐，再观察价格能否走出与资金同向的确认；若两者背离，以价格和风险控制为先。

市场反应也并不配合简单的乐观标题。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2,436美元，低于日开约2,472；当日低点约2,434、高点约2,525。这里不能把跌幅单因归于ETF，宏观风险、BTC波动和合约去杠杆都可能同时作用。对我而言，2,460是短线重新夺回的第一关，2,490是上方初步兑现区；若2,434低点再被有效跌破，所谓资金面改善至少还没转成可交易的价格强势。反过来，主要基金补报后总量仍为正，且价格站稳2,460并守住回踩，才会提高我对反弹延续的信心。

如果是我自己交易：当前不参与追多，方向仅预设小仓位现货多单。只有价格上破2,460美元并在回踩中守住，我才以总资金最多2%试仓，不使用高杠杆；第一目标2,490先减半，第二目标2,520再减剩余。入场后跌回2,425下方止损；若两次冲击2,490失败，或ETHA补报令21日合计转负，我会提前平仓而不是用叙事硬扛。若始终不触发入场条件，就维持空仓，计划不是成交记录。

III. Market interpretation
The facts are clear: after a bullish candle with nearly triple the usual volume, the price is almost back where it started a day later, giving back all of its gains. One possible explanation is that the volume included many short-term and leveraged positions, and that liquidations triggered during the surge led to forced selling that pushed the price back to its starting point. 一、图片事实
图为 ETH/USDT 4 小时 K 线，共 60 根，数据取自币安官方 K 线接口，本地绘制，截图时间 2026-10-22 11:13（UTC+8）。最右侧一根（08:00 开盘）尚未走完，图中 2,439.60 是截图时的最新价，不是收盘价。

二、关键证据
1. 10-21 20:00 那根 4 小时 K 线：开 2,469.37、高 2,515.70、收 2,512.54，成交 99,870.45 ETH，是此前 20 根已走完 K 线均量 35,767.04 ETH 的 2.79 倍。
2. 从那根高点 2,515.70 算起，最新价 2,439.60 已回落 3.03%，并且跌到那根阳线的开盘价 2,469.37 之下（-1.21%）。
3. 24 小时前的收盘价是 2,444.30，最新价 2,439.60，净变化 -0.19%。

三、市场解读
事实部分是清楚的：近三倍量的一根阳线，一天之后价格几乎原地不动，涨幅全部交出。放量本身只能证明那个 4 小时里换手剧烈，不能证明换手之后筹码留在谁手里。一种推测是：这根量里包含大量短线与杠杆头寸，冲高触发清算后，被动卖盘把价格压回起点。这是推测，不是事实——要区分它，需要持仓量和资金费率的同步数据，本文没有取。

四、反向验证
看空这个结构的理由并不充分。最新价仍站在 20 根已走完 4 小时收盘均线 2,429.57 上方 0.41%，均线本身还在向上，趋势结构没有被破坏。另外当前这根 4 小时只走完约四分之三，低点 2,437.00 随时可能被改写。如果 12:00 那根能收在 2,469.37 之上，那"放量白费"这个说法就要撤回，改称一次回踩确认。

五、后续观察
就看 12:00 收盘的那根 4 小时 K 线：收盘价在 2,469.37 上方还是下方。这一个数字就能决定上面两种解释哪种站得住。

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Position Sizing: How to Add as a Trend Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in heavily from the start and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized gains is a surefire way to become a
regular on the liquidation list. The right approach is called pyramid position sizing.

【Principle】Each addition should be smaller than the previous one. For example: start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position size; your cost basis stays weighted toward lower levels, so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the Reverse Is Dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, all your decisions go off track.

subTitle:

Jesse Pollak 10月21日发了句很短的话：200ms blocks live on testnet, mainnet soon。对照官方文档，这是Denim升级——Base Sepolia按计划在UTC 18:00切到原生200毫秒出块：从每2秒一块，变成每秒5个完整规范区块；原来的Flashblocks预确认流退役，应用要迁到canonical的newHeads这类订阅。

干货在「副作用」：每个200ms块有自己的hash、state root和收据生命周期；EVM的block.timestamp还是按秒走，毫秒靠BaseTime元数据补；但block.number变快了约10倍——合约里用「数块当冷却时间」的，主网一旦跟上，会缩成原来的十分之一。主网目标写在11月，文档也提醒：没钉死时间戳的月份只是规划，可能改。

不是行情段子，是L2在把链上反馈往「接近刷卡」推。测网已报live，主网再盯。

translatedData.title: Base testnet hits 200ms blocks: Flashblocks first to be retired
translatedData.subTitle:
Base, the Coinbase-backed network, has tightened its block-production cadence by a notch on testnet first.

On October 21, Jesse Pollak posted a short message: “200ms blocks live on testnet, mainnet soon.” According to the official docs, this is the Denim upgrade: Base Sepolia is scheduled to switch to native 200-millisecond block production at 18:00 UTC—going from one block every 2 seconds to five full canonical blocks per second. The old Flashblocks preconfirmation stream is being retired, and apps will need to migrate to subscriptions such as canonical newHeads.

The key caveat: each 200ms block has its own hash, state root, and receipt lifecycle. EVM's block.timestamp still advances in seconds, with milliseconds supplied by BaseTime metadata. But block.number advances about 10 times faster—once mainnet catches up, any contract that uses a number of blocks as a cooldown will see that period shrink to one-tenth its original length. Mainnet is targeted for November, but the docs warn that months without a firm date are only tentative plans and may change.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
shouldn’t exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
Your account is only down 20%; a few good trades can get you back. On the other hand, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
after three losses in a row, you’re left with just 34%. You’d need to nearly double your money to break even—mathematically, you’re basically already out of the game.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the distance to the stop → work backward to determine your position size.
